scope: Horizontal black tide animation; includes prior rocket, helmet and loadout fixes. Other dirty work preserved.

changes.sequence: After native monologue closes: black wave and horizontal wake sweep right to left in 2.4 seconds; surviving dream actors fall at 0.1 second intervals, Afei last; fade from 3.4 to 4.6 seconds then native exit.
changes.direction: Default right-to-left; backend also supports mirrored left-to-right. No rising waterline remains behind the wave.
changes.clock: Real-time backend progress; virtual menu pause cannot stall the animation. Frontend has no animation timer.
changes.safety: Freeze input, native actor queue and parallel AI during ending; clear layer at tactical finish, restoration, load/new-campaign boundaries. Frontend token fence rejects stale messages.
changes.render: Code-native Canvas overlay outside hidden tactical HUD; real Canvas pixel snapshots reviewed. No extra raster game assets.

visual_preview.method: Skia-backed @napi-rs/canvas executes shipped production JS with real Canvas 2D drawing

limits: No game was launched for this revision.
Canvas pixel preview uses a historical static battle screenshot, not a game recording.
Native CEF canvas visibility, actual staggered deaths, loading-to-wake transition, scaling and full campaign acceptance remain pending.
